message.content:
The cover of "TEMPO" magazine features a stylized illustration of a man with a large, caricatured head, dark hair, and a slight smile. He is wearing a dark suit with a pink tie and white collared shirt. He is shown in a three-quarter profile, kneeling on one knee on a flat green surface that resembles turf. He is tying the laces of a white, low-top athletic shoe with studs on its sole.

The man’s body occupies a large portion of the left and center of the frame. The background is a solid, dark green color. To the right of the man, white and bold text reads: “GERILYA BEREBUT PSSI.” Smaller text below this states: “Tragedi Kanjuruhan mendorong restrukturisasi Persatuan Sepak Bola Seluruh Indonesia. Manuver pendukung Menteri BUMN Erick Thohir merebut kursi Ketua Umum PSSI. H.40.”

Across the top of the cover, additional text reads: “Sengkarut Data Stok Beras H.98” and “Resolusi Kongres Ulama Perempuan H.76.” A barcode, QR code, and publication details like "5-11 DESEMBER 2022" and "RP 50.000" are visible in the top right corner.
